evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies transaction creation in src/wallet/spend.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an int64 overflow and node assertion crash in CreateTransaction when recipient amounts exceed MAX_MONEY. According to the PR description, the overflow triggers an assertion failure in RecalculateWaste ('assert(!m_selected_inputs.empty())') or wraps around to a small positive sum, allowing fundrawtransaction to succeed on invalid outputs.
